description_md:
Join us in a special weekend developer experience! We're long time San Diego developers, looking to foster a community of devs of all skill levels to have fun, network, and learn new things!

# ​**What to Expect**

​For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks. After, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer and engineering topics.

​Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and make exciting new friends.

​Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.

​Please be courteous and respectful to others.

# ​**What to Bring**

​Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, bring your 💻 laptop! We want to see what you're excited about. Whether it's an app you're building, a new library you found, or what you learned last week about useEffect().

# ​**Food**

​We have complimentary 🍕🥕food and 🍺🥤beverages. Please help yourself!

# ​**Agenda**

​12:00 Networking Lunch

1:00 Speaker Presentations

2:00 Community Announcements

2:15 Network / Hangout / Code

4:00 End

# ​**Speaker Topics**

We typically have three speakers presenting various developer related talks. If you're interested in giving a talk please submit a request using this form: [https://forms.gle/VEvKkKPJSgZEhzPN9](https://forms.gle/VEvKkKPJSgZEhzPN9)

# Our Community

You can find more information about our community at [https://devx.network](https://devx.network)

Also, join our Discord community to ask what others are interested in learning in the #event-talk channel: [https://discord.gg/hyf9KSaKtv](https://discord.gg/hyf9KSaKtv)

# ​**How to get there**

## ​Suggested Car Parking

*   ​Street ($0)
*   ​[San Diego County Waterfront Garage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sT8BXxgKDcJKjQt2A) ($20)
*   ​[Fashion Valley Mall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P9ovewu3u6XicwnG7) ($5)
    *   ​take the green line from `Fashion Valley Transit Center` to `County Center/Little Italy Station`
    *   ​costs `$2.50` each way

## ​Suggested Bike Parking

*   ​[Waterfront Park](http://\(https://maps.app.goo.gl/53cb8AWX3cepfsXu8\))

## ​Suggested Rails

*   ​[Green and Blue Trolly Lines](https://www.sdmts.com/transit-services/trolley)
    *   ​stop at [County Center/Little Italy Station](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aum84xGfsFhF2RGa9)
*   ​[Coaster](https://gonctd.com/wp-content/uploads/COASTER-Schedule-October-2024-Web.pdf)
    *   ​stop at [Santa Fe Depot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vtxdo1xSpREVUZoD9)

# ​**What to Expect**

​For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks. After, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer and engineering topics.

​Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and make exciting new friends.

​Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.

​Please be courteous and respectful to others.

# ​**What to Bring**

​Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, bring your 💻 laptop! We want to see what you're excited about. Whether it's an app you're building, a new library you found, or what you learned last week about useEffect().

# ​**Food**

​We have complimentary 🍕🥕food and 🍺🥤beverages. Please help yourself!

# ​**Agenda**

​12:00 Networking Lunch

1:00 Speaker Presentations

2:00 Community Announcements

2:15 Network / Hangout / Code

4:00 End

We typically have three speakers presenting various developer related talks. If you're interested in giving a talk please submit a request using this form: [https://forms.gle/VEvKkKPJSgZEhzPN9](https://forms.gle/VEvKkKPJSgZEhzPN9)

![](https://images.lumacdn.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,dpr=2,anim=false,background=white,quality=75,width=800/editor-images/9j/8955f4df-6f3b-4d66-9565-5d961e274e2d.png)

​Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and make exciting new friends.

​Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.

​Please be courteous and respectful to others.

# ​**What to Bring**

​Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, bring your 💻 laptop! We want to see what you're excited about. Whether it's an app you're building, a new library you found, or what you learned last week about useEffect().

# ​**Food**

​We have complimentary 🍕🥕food and 🍺🥤beverages. Please help yourself!

​12:00 Networking Lunch

1:00 Speaker Presentations

2:00 Community Announcements

2:15 Network / Hangout / Code

4:00 End

description:
Join us in a special weekend developer experience! We're long time San Diego developers, looking to foster a community of devs of all skill levels to have fun, network, and learn new things!
What to Expect
For this monthly meetup, we gather for lunch to introduce ourselves and enjoy complimentary food and drinks. After, we start a series of presentations from members of the community to share interesting developer and engineering topics.
Once presentations are finished, we break into groups to casually network, show off our projects and make exciting new friends.
Feel free to ask our organizers for help on some code you're struggling with, if you are! We're happy to help where we can.
Please be courteous and respectful to others.
What to Bring
Should you be giving a presentation or want to share a project, bring your 💻 laptop! We want to see what you're excited about. Whether it's an app you're building, a new library you found, or what you learned last week about useEffect().
Food
We have complimentary 🍕🥕food and 🍺🥤beverages. Please help yourself!
Agenda
12:00: Networking Lunch
12:30: Speaker Presentations
1:30: Breakout Sessions
4:00 Closing
Speaker Topics
We typically have three speakers presenting various developer related talks. If you're interested in giving a talk please submit a request using this form: https://forms.gle/VEvKkKPJSgZEhzPN9
Our Community
You can find more information about our community at https://devx.network
